source.modifications: Unofficial outline interpretation for social links. 圓框恢復原 24 單位直徑並向內描；三道原聲波的曲率、漸細與長短維持不變，右上留白回到原始比例。 Strokes baked to fixed filled paths; optical placement at 16/20/24 px.

source.library: Master Icons; Tabler Icons; Simple Icons brand contours
source.author: Paweł Kuna; Master and contributors
source.modifications: Unofficial outline interpretation for social links. 沿用原雲形的飽滿上肩與右側小弧，外框向內描；改為四根漸高聲柱，主雲與聲柱保持原標誌的寬扁節奏。 Strokes baked to fixed filled paths; optical placement at 16/20/24 px.
